title: Web CDK bundling docker cannot read Cognito SSM without a region
description:
Production and development web deploys fail while bundling the Next.js asset.

The SAM Node docker image runs `aws ssm get-parameter` for Cognito public config (`infra/lib/web-build-env.ts`) with no `--region` and no `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`. GitHub sets `aws-region: us-east-1` on the runner; CDK does not forward it into the bundling container.

Failed runs:
- Deploy Web (production) after develop→main: https://github.com/AnthusAI/Chattic.us/actions/runs/33818669077
- Deploy Web (development): https://github.com/AnthusAI/Chattic.us/actions/runs/33816545135

Error: `An error occurred (NoRegion): You must specify a region.`

This blocks shipping the `/beta` nav fix (already on main via PR 279) to chattic.us.

DoD: `webBuildEnvExports` / docker bundle command sets the region so SSM works inside the bundling image; existing `infra/test/web-build-env.test.ts` asserts it; web deploy can succeed. No Gherkin — this is CDK bundling, not visitor-facing behavior.
